known.title: Gate: unrelated review-bar changes outside Scope

findings.body:
Gain 4, Work 2, Harm 2
Raise: Gate. Case: normal use - delivering the services guides also ships unrelated changes to which review findings block a merge. This line loads review-bar settings, with corresponding changes in src/forge/nextstep.py, src/forge/repo.py, src/forge/score.py, src/forge/templates/review.md and tests/test_review_bar.py. None of these six files is needed to deliver the services paragraph, adoption step, worker instructions or init/sync coverage required by item 3. Keep the review-bar implementation in its separate change and remove these files' changes, plus the corresponding review-bar hunks in the otherwise permitted templates and generated guides, from this target.
